$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKJ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
Procedures (arrivals, departures, special VFR, radio failure) were then structured by hand from the English column of the text pages; what the chart only draws is not recorded.
name: Ajaccio Napoléon Bonaparte

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, procedures structured by hand

service.atsHours: H 24 - AD AJACCIO NAPOLEON BONAPARTE BP 70979 - 20700 Ajaccio CEDEX 9 (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

circuit.lowHeight: 500 ft AMSL; training flights authorised only with an instructor pilot; downwind leg east of the runway; runway 20: use the touchdown marking as the aiming point, not the displaced threshold marking
circuit.restrictions: landing lights compulsory in the CTR

arrivals.note: maritime transit mainland / Ajaccio: aircraft coming from LONSU are recommended to reach or cross NW at 2000 ft AMSL; in a maritime crossing the compulsory arrival and departure route is NW <-> W
unless otherwise cleared, recommended altitude 2000 ft AMSL maximum; W to SA preferential altitude 2000 ft AMSL; SA to W preferential altitude 1500 ft AMSL
unless otherwise cleared, recommended flight levels above FL055; N to SEA preferential FL075; SEA to N preferential FL065

routes of arrival and departure for other flights: northbound WA <-> W <-> NW; southbound SB <-> SA <-> S; minimum altitude 3000 ft AMSL; visibility of at least 5 km below FL100; on pilot request and after clearance, the pilot in charge of obstacle clearance may depart from these routes

departures.note: take-off runway 02 and missed landing runway 02: climb on the runway heading, reach 1000 ft AMSL minimum at the latest 2 NM after the displaced threshold of runway 20, then turn left while continuing the climb

withAts.waiting: holding in flight is possible at SA and W between 3000 ft and 5000 ft to avoid interference with IFR flights
withAts.specialVfr: in the presence of IFR aircraft in the CTR: visibility 3000 m, ceiling 1000 ft AAL

nightVfr.restrictions: landing on runway 20 prohibited; activity prohibited if the hazard light of Monte Sant'Angelo is not available; local flights limited to 1 aircraft at most
nightVfr.circuit: west of runway 02/20, altitude 1500 ft AMSL
nightVfr.flightInTheCtr: cloud base at least 3500 ft AAL, visibility at least 5 km, minimum altitude 3000 ft AMSL
nightVfr.helicopters: FATO not usable at night: take off and land on the runway; night VFR minima: visibility 4000 m and ceiling 1000 ft AAL on route SB-SA and WA-W without IFR aircraft in the CTR or other helicopters in special VFR (holding possible); special VFR by night: a delay is to be expected if IFR traffic is in the CTR

radio.failure: if possible, use a mobile phone to call the tower on +33 4 95 23 59 60
radio.failureOnArrival: before the clearance to enter the class D airspace, do not enter it; after the clearance to enter the CTR, follow the last clearance, do not interfere with runway 02/20 and follow the optical signals; the tower chief may be called on 04 95 20 11 95 (emergency number only)
radio.failureOnDeparture: before take-off cancel the departure and return to the parking; after take-off turn back, join the downwind leg of the runway in use, do not interfere with runway 02/20 and follow the optical signals

notes: (1) MAX thrust offset for B747, B757 and B763: reduction 92 m.
Non home-based ULM: Use of AD only with agreement from apron control (PCE) and ATS services.
Contact: pce1@cci.corsica (or 04 95 23 56 19) and temps-reel.ajaccio@aviation-civile.gouv.fr PPR 48 HR.
Important bird presence (AD and vicinity).
High voltage line R 020/1,3 NM DTHR 20, peak altitude 211 ft AMSL, height up to 130 ft AGL, only pylons are lighted at night.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
In the CTR, regular activity of air photography with a drone.
MAX height: 500 ft ASFC.
To safeguard property and people, some summer day, heavy seaplane activity in phase of bailing in the vicinity of the aerodrome in Porticcio bay and in Ajaccio harbour.
Paraglider activity in the vicinity of CTR on an axis crossing N, NZ and NV.
Towed paragliding activity from a boat, with a non-visible nylon cable approximately 450 m long, up to a MAX height of 1000 ft in "Golfe de Sagone", Liscia bay.
Special caution recommended.
TWY H: MAX wingspan 24 m day time use only.
TWY F: only for Civil safety ACFT and towed ACFT with a MAX wingspan of 36 m.
TWY A/C/D/D1/D2/E/G1/G2: MAX wingspan 36 m TWY B: MAX wingspan 65 m.
TWY T: MAX wingspan 36 m.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0) and ADS-B.
Aerobatics (NR 7000): axis RWY 02/20 centered on AD ARP; 3000 AMSL / 5000 AMSL; SR-SS with AJACCIO TWR authorization.
Activity prohibited on SAT, SUN and HOL from May 1st to September 30th.
Meteo conditions: Visi > 5 km - Ceiling > 5000 ft.
AEM (NR 9621): 300 AAL; activity authorized according to the draft agreement with the associations.
Users' information on ATIS or ATC FREQ.
